scenarios.name: Apply a deck filter from card browser search
scenarios.reason:
Opened the app from its welcome screen and went to Settings.
Enabled the “New card browser search view” option under Developer options.
Returned to the deck list, opened Card browser, and selected All decks in Deck search.
The leftmost search filter chip now shows “All decks,” completing the requested check.
